description: Rename or move ANY markdown file — a plain (non-task) note OR a TaskNotes file — addressed by its vault-relative PATH (not a task id). Rewrites every OTHER task's dependsOn/projects fields AND every file's body/prose [[wikilink]]/[display](path) references to follow it (the SAME propagation move_task/archive_task use). Refuses if new_path already exists — no auto-suffix; pass a different destination. dry_run:true computes and returns the propagation counts WITHOUT writing anything, including the physical rename itself.

dry_run.description:
Preview only — compute and return the propagation counts WITHOUT
writing to disk at all (not even the physical rename). The response
carries `dry_run: true`.

new_path.description:
The destination vault-relative path. The call is refused if this
already exists — pass a free path explicitly.

name: move_note
